Freeze the question before inspecting evaluation results

Predict: does renaming an already-inspected dataset “evaluation” make it an unseen test?

Step 4/4: Report deviations and exposure
If you inspect, tune and rerun, disclose the sequence and label affected conclusions exploratory. A new label does not restore independence.

All steps and numerical explanations

  1. Develop on earlier evidence

    Use development evidence to choose a bounded rule and assumptions. Record every tried alternative, including losing ones.

  2. Freeze the analysis plan

    Record question, inputs, benchmark, costs and stopping rule before revealing the evaluation outcomes.

  3. Inspect evaluation once as planned

    Run the declared analysis and retain both predefined cost cases. The course’s source is public: a local gate cannot prove genuinely unseen data or external preregistration.

  4. Report deviations and exposure

    If you inspect, tune and rerun, disclose the sequence and label affected conclusions exploratory. A new label does not restore independence.

A teaching sequence, not proof of independent validation. This diagram reveals no capstone evaluation numbers.
